name: @w6w-apps/bubble
description: Read, write and trigger workflows against a Bubble app's own Data API and Workflow API.

w6w.longDescription:
Bubble is a no-code app builder, and this app talks to the two API surfaces a Bubble application itself exposes: the Data API (direct CRUD against whichever Data Types the builder has turned on) and the Workflow API (triggering the app's own named, server-side API Workflows).

Because every Bubble app is its own deployment with its own database schema, the shapes here stay generic — a Data Type name and a JSON object of fields, rather than fixed field lists — so this app works against any Bubble application, not one specific schema. Search, read, create, update, replace, delete and bulk-create cover the Data API's full surface; triggering an API Workflow by name covers the Workflow API, for anything the app builder has wired up beyond plain CRUD, from sending an email to running a multi-step process.

Left out on purpose: user-level authentication (logging a specific end-user in runs through a bespoke API Workflow every app builder designs differently, with no fixed endpoint to call generically) and bulk update/delete, which Bubble's Data API does not offer at all — only bulk create.
